title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1982-02-19
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB/6th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji FeCr Tape/Dolby DB)

ai_review.summary: Front‑of‑board soundboard capture with crystal‑clear separation showcases a high‑energy show highlighted by a monster “Other One” and stellar Garcia solos.
ai_review.review: The recording is a front‑of‑board (soundboard) gem, praised for its crisp separation of instruments and Jerry’s guitar sitting right up front. The performance itself is fire‑breathing – the first set shines with Bertha, Dire Wolf and a killer Althea, while the post‑drums jam erupts into one of the decade’s best “Other One” stretches, complete with an ecstatic space jam and a sweet Stella Blue. Overall the show radiates high energy and tight musicianship throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both the musical performance and the front‑of‑board sound quality; only a single low rating appears and does not detract from the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑board tape captured by Rango Keshavan, enhanced by Charlie Miller; reviewers note superb instrument separation (especially drums and Jerry’s guitar), a clean, crisp mix with the only minor complaint being vocals slightly buried.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first‑set highlights followed by a well‑played pre‑drums segment; post‑drums space jam flows seamlessly into an epic Other One, closing with an unusual Women Smart → Johnny B. Goode tag.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Slide work in the first break, a scorching solo on Red Rooster, and lead guitar throughout – described as “playing like a god” with his tone front‑and‑center.
band_member_comments.Phil: Great time on bass, repeatedly hitting the “earthquake riff” during the Other One jam; overall powerful presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar praised on Greatest Story Ever Told, adding solid drive to the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboards balanced nicely – not swallowing Garcia’s guitar as in some other recordings.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drums tight and well‑played; post‑drums section launches into a dynamic space jam with clear separation of both drummers.
